title: This group is amazing and we are on the verge of discovering something new that should be studied.
content: Do I actually believe in the "mall world"? I don't know. What I do know is multiple people are experiencing shared traits in their dreams. Like I never told anyone about the train station and suddenly everyone is talking about a train station connected to the mall Malls don't typically have train stations at least where I live. Why is it that every person imagined the same thing? It's not like this is a popular NoSleeo or Creepypasta. While the backrooms have become very popular none of the lore talks about the mall. Why are we all experiencing this? There has to be ways we can experiment with this. Maybe try to make a map.
